minimalityRationale.actions: Actions(write) is needed by the two observed rerun mutations and subsumes Actions(read) for run/job/log/artifact reads.
minimalityRationale.contents: Contents(write) is needed by raw Git object creation, file mutations and PR merge, and subsumes Contents(read).
minimalityRationale.issues: Issues(write) is needed by issue creation/update and issue-reaction mutations, and subsumes Issues(read).
minimalityRationale.metadata: Metadata(read) is needed by repository lookup/discovery, installation repository enumeration and collaborator permission.
minimalityRationale.pull_requests: Pull requests(write) is needed by PR creation/update/reviews/reviewers/comments/reactions and is the least-privilege candidate for the observed GraphQL PR operations.
minimalityRationale.statuses: Commit statuses(read) is needed by get_commit_combined_status; no target action writes commit statuses.
minimalityRationale.workflows: Workflows(write) is conditionally required by file/ref mutations when .github/workflows content is affected; native file/ref actions accept arbitrary targets, so practical parity needs it.

graphqlPermissionEvidence.officialGuidance: GitHub instructs GitHub App developers to test GraphQL queries/mutations for required permissions; insufficient permission returns 401.
graphqlPermissionEvidence.candidateWhy: All observed GraphQL operations are pull-request/review-thread resources, and Pull requests(write) is independently required by REST parity actions.

searchPermissionEvidence.policy: Do not invent a Search permission. Search visibility is constrained by the user/app repository/resource intersection; mapped resource permissions already cover private target data.

fetchFacadeEvidence.policy: The bounded native fetch facade is endpoint/resource dependent. It must remain inside the same fixed manifest and reject endpoint families requiring permissions outside it, including Administration-only resources.
